cells.gaps: The Council of Ministers adopted the National Digital Policy on 14 October 2026, but no source gives its text, its period, a delivery plan or reporting. The 2020 World Bank statements of absence (BDI-001, BDI-002) are superseded.
cells.note: Instrument: Politique nationale du numérique, adopted by the Council of Ministers on 14 October 2026. Stage 3 needs its text public and a period that has not ended, and neither is held.
